## Disposition and attribution

Accept a complete, credited prior counterexample for 30000977 / OWR-1971-010. The bound degree <= 4 is false: the Gleissner–Pignatelli–Rito surface has exactly nine A2 canonical singularities, Cartier ample base-point-free K, K squared 24, pg=4, and complete canonical morphism of degree 12 onto a singular rank-three quadric cone in P3. The image has degree 2, hence minimal degree. The degree-27 construction cover onto P1 x P1 is a distinct map.

Credit: Christian Gleissner, Roberto Pignatelli and Carlos Rito, *New surfaces with canonical map of high degree*, Communications in Analysis and Geometry 30(8) (2022), 1811–1823, [DOI](https://doi.org/10.4310/cag.2022.v30.n8.a5). Mathematical text inspected: Section 6 of [arXiv:1807.11854v2](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1807.11854v2). Original target: [OWR 26/2008, printed pp.1462 and 1464](https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/46169). The publisher text was not inspected; publisher/preprint equivalence and persistence of preprint typos are not claimed.

Read unchanged current/PROOF_AUDIT.md and the complete current/SECOND_AUDIT.md. Their arguments establish existence/connectedness, every stabilizer and singularity, Cartierness, ampleness, finite duality, all four canonical sections, base-point-freeness including singular points, finiteness and degree. The inspected preprint's rank-two group notation is corrected to (Z/3Z)^3, and its section-divisor relation to 2A=B+D. The contextual patch clarifies the inverse-eigenline convention and records independent acceptance; no mathematical correction to the accepted construction is required.

This is a credited audit, not a new counterexample or a broader classification. No general upper bound or canonical-map Galois property is claimed. Three of five exploratory routes preceded discovery of the existing example; this audit adds zero new proof-search turns. Historical manifests, source-retrieval/inspection metadata, original proof and complete checker logs retain their dates and former acceptance state; they are not fresh publication-stage source evidence.

## Reproduction and acceptance boundary

The unchanged original checker covers 27 characters, 25 branch strata, inertia intersections, divisors and invariant arithmetic. The independent checker derives normalized differentials from six Kummer equations and checks 729 character pairs against 27 group elements (19,683 evaluations), sixteen crossings, 625 invariant-monomial interfaces, all 27 canonical summands, all four divisors, all 25 strata, the exact rational differential relation, quadric rank and degree arithmetic. Geometry is established by the two full written audits, not by these finite checks.

Fresh normal/-O/-OO replay has six positive checker runs and fifty-one intended mutant rejections: five original and twelve independent mutants in each mode. All inner stdout/stderr bytes, exits, expected identities and reasons equal their fixed audited contracts. The wrapper's complete output equals authenticated mode-specific raw references without normalization, with recursive exact JSON types. Duplicate keys, non-finite values, empty/skip/failed suites, changed counts and changed identities cannot pass. Publication integrity/schema/comparator controls are accounted separately from mathematical mutants. The contextual patch was freshly applied with zero fuzz and yielded the exact accepted proof bytes.

Authenticate BOOTSTRAP.py with the independent SHA-256 below and save it outside the packet. Set all packet files to 0444 and directories to 0555, and run as actual UID=EUID=1000:

- python -I -S -B /trusted/BOOTSTRAP.py --controls /path/to/packet
- python -I -S -B -O /trusted/BOOTSTRAP.py --controls /path/to/packet
- python -I -S -B -OO /trusted/BOOTSTRAP.py --controls /path/to/packet

The fixed external bootstrap binds the manifest, verifier and control harness before execution; the manifest binds every other delivered file, including all historical/pre-seal receipts, contracts and raw references. The bootstrap is pinned outside the inventory and binds the manifest, avoiding circular hashes. Final external replay receipts remain outside the delivered inventory. CPython 3.12.14 and its standard library are trusted dependencies; no external proof code is used. The local zero-fuzz contextual-patch preparation used the system patch executable. Read-only create/append/unlink denials and before/after hashes are checked, including under hostile import environments. Permission modes deter accidental writes, not intentional owner chmod or root access.

Full historical-harness, source-body, publisher-text, published/preprint-equivalence, new-source-search, dataset, source-classification and formal-proof-assistant stages are NOT_RUN. Source PDFs, extracted source text, images, dataset contents, private sources, private coordination and identifying metadata for excluded private files are absent. Only the target attempt directory is added; no QUEUE or unrelated changes.
